typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style TSRole.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style TSRole.

recognitionRules: Use a clear Arial name and focus hierarchy.
Reserve Courier New for technical identifiers, not whole paragraphs.
Group relevant experience with readable dates and role labels.
Use textual evidence instead of proficiency bars or keyword clouds.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Show the system, the contribution and the evidence that it worked.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THE TECHNICAL RECORD in Arial with a small Courier identifier. No terminal prompt icon or code-bracket badge.
invariants: Use a clear Arial name and focus hierarchy.
Reserve Courier New for technical identifiers, not whole paragraphs.
Group relevant experience with readable dates and role labels.
adaptations: Tailor the opening focus to the role while retaining factual experience.
Keep technical terms only when they clarify the work.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
